description: Performance floor for TownSuite.WorkQueues.Server on the redis backend (Valkey 8.1). run_loadtest.sh runs every scenario with the server and Valkey limited to 2 CPUs and 1 GB each; a result outside these thresholds fails the build. Throughput floors recalibrated on 2026-10-25 to about 70% of the first Jenkins run (PR-20 build #5: steady 1523 published/s and 3020 delivered/s, fanout 517 and 5129); p99 caps are 3x or more what Jenkins measured. Tighten from the reports Jenkins archives (build/loadtest/report.json); loosen only with a reason in the commit message.
